_comment: Benchmark OpenZeppelin's canton-token-template — THIRD-PARTY Canton code we
did not write — through the real CIP-0056 interface choice
Their transfer does a 3-way dispatch: self-transfer (merge), direct transfer
(when a TransferPreapproval is supplied in the choice context), and the
two-step path. With an empty context and sender != receiver this exercises
the TWO-STEP path: archive the inputs, create a LockedSimpleHolding plus a
Submitters: SimpleTokenRules is `signatory admin` with no observers, so the
sender cannot see it. This uses EXPLICIT DISCLOSURE — the factory's
created-event blob is captured once during setup and attached to every
submission — which is exactly how a wallet reaches a registry's factory.
The sender submits alone; the admin does not co-sign.
